katlctl: act only on timely, positive management evidence (#748)

* katlctl: stop enable-mtls acting on replies past its deadline

A Begin reply that arrived just after the call's deadline, before
the client context reported cancellation, was treated as success,
and the command went on to confirm the trial on fresh budgets. Check
cancellation and the absolute deadline before acting on any reply,
so an expired call reports an interrupted trial that the operator
resumes by rerunning. Drive the enable-mtls timeout tests with
testing/synctest's virtual clock instead of wall-clock timing.

Fixes #741.

Release-Note: katlctl management enable-mtls no longer confirms a trial after its --timeout has expired

* katlctl: treat late management RPC results as inconclusive

Management RPC results that arrived at or after their call deadline
were used as evidence: an expired mTLS preflight error fell back to
plaintext, an expired plaintext-refusal probe let enable-mtls publish
the mTLS configuration, and late replies advanced rotation, recovery,
context rebind and saved-context refresh. The shared management dial
options now return a distinct inconclusive error for any result at
or after the deadline or after cancellation, and callers stop with
guidance instead of acting on it. Rotation counts only a timely
certificate refusal from the old credential as rejection.

Release-Note: katlctl stops instead of acting on management replies that arrive after their timeout

* docs: describe inconclusive management checks and their retries

Quote the guidance enable-mtls, identity rotate, identity recover,
context rebind and host shutdown now print when a management check
is inconclusive, and cover the shared contract that any result at or
after a call's deadline is inconclusive for unary and streaming calls.

Release-Note: skip

* katlctl: prove old-CA removal before rotation advances

Rotation counted an expired or revoked client certificate alert as proof
that a node no longer trusted the old authority, although such an alert
only rejects that one leaf. Rotation now presents a freshly minted
leaf from the old CA and advances only on a timely unknown_ca alert
followed by a successful recheck with the replacement credential. Any
other alert stops it with guidance. A rerun whose node is unreachable
keeps the configured replacement and tells the operator to check the
endpoint instead of restoring the previous reference.

Release-Note: katlctl management identity rotate advances only after a node rejects the old certificate authority itself

* katlctl: say an interrupted enable-mtls trial reverts by itself

Keep the safety fact in the interrupted-trial guidance: if the window
ends before confirmation, the node returns to trusted-network by
itself. The guidance no longer quotes a computed time. The VM journey,
unit tests and runbook quote the final wording.

Release-Note: skip

* katlctl: keep rotation retries stable under clock skew

Anchor the fresh old-CA probe's validity to the old CA's own start,
so a node whose clock runs behind still reaches the issuer check on
every retry. Advise restoring the previous secrets reference only
when local verification rejects the server certificate's authority;
a connection lost after ServerHello keeps the replacement and asks
the operator to check the endpoint.

Release-Note: skip

* katlctl: advance management rollouts only on positive evidence

Rotate, recover and enable-mtls classified TLS alerts and connection
errors into trust conclusions, and each review found another case
where that inference misled the operator. One classifier in the
management transport now sorts each result into confirmed, explicit
refusal or inconclusive. Rollouts advance only after a successful
authenticated call with the replacement credential, plus a timely
unknown_ca rejection of a fresh old-CA leaf for rotation. Anything
else stops before the next node or any publication and reports what
could not be confirmed and how to rerun or check status. Rollback
is never advised from inference. #747 replaces the inference with an
agent report of trusted CAs.

Release-Note: skip

* katlctl: bind trust evidence to the call that produced it

Context save and rebind no longer suggest switching to trusted-network
or restoring secrets after a failed handshake; they report uncertain
trust through the shared classifier. Rotation counts unknown_ca
only from the probe's own single handshake within its deadline. A
late result from katlc agent over SSH is inconclusive under the same
deadline rule as the management transport, so rotation and recovery
preflight stop instead of moving to the next node.

Release-Note: katlctl management enable-mtls, identity rotate and identity recover stop with guidance instead of acting on late or inconclusive replies from a node
